documentChunks.text: # APEX INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY & SCIENCE
## OFFICIAL ACADEMIC REGULATIONS & EXAMINATION RULES (ACADEMIC YEAR 2026-2027)

### 1. ATTENDANCE REQUIREMENTS

1.1. Minimum Mandatory Attendance:

Every registered student is required to maintain a minimum attendance of 75% in aggregate of all lectures, practical sessions, tutorials, and laboratories conducted in each semester to be eligible for appearing in the End-Semester Final Examinations.


1.2. Attendance Condonation on Medical Grounds:

Students having attendance between 65% and 74.9% may be considered for condonation of attendance shortage by the Academic Dean, strictly on valid medical grounds (hospitalization certificate certified by the Chief Medical Officer) or representation of the College in State/National sports and cultural events. A condonation fee of $50 / Rs. 1,500 per course applies.


1.3. Detainment:

Medical Officer) or representation of the College in State/National sports and cultural events. A condonation fee of $50 / Rs. 1,500 per course applies.


1.3. Detainment:

Students who secure less than 65% aggregate attendance shall be detained in that semester and will NOT be allowed to appear for the End-Semester Examination under any circumstances. They must re-register for the entire semester with the subsequent batch upon paying the re-admission fees.

### 2. GRADING SYSTEM & EVALUATION SCHEME
2.1. Assessment Split:
- Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE): 40%
- Mid-Term Test 1: 15%
- Mid-Term Test 2: 15%
- Quizzes, Assignments, and Mini-Projects: 10%
- Semester End Examination (SEE): 60%

2.2. Letter Grades and Grade Points:
- O (Outstanding): 90 - 100% | Grade Point: 10
- A+ (Excellent): 80 - 89% | Grade Point: 9
- A (Very Good): 70 - 79% | Grade Point: 8
- B+ (Good): 60 - 69% | Grade Point: 7
- B (Above Average): 55 - 59% | Grade Point: 6
- C (Average): 50 - 54% | Grade Point: 5
- P (Pass): 40 - 49% | Grade Point: 4
- F (Fail / Absent): Below 40% | Grade Point: 0

2.3. Minimum Passing Criteria:
A student must secure at least 40% marks in SEE (24 out of 60) and 40% overall (CIE + SEE) to clear any course.

### 3. SEMESTER EXAMINATIONS & ARREARS POLICY
3.1. Examination Schedule:
- Odd Semesters (I, III, V, VII): Theory examinations begin in the 3rd week of November. Practical exams commence in the 1st week of November.
- Even Semesters (II, IV, VI, VIII): Theory examinations begin in the 3rd week of April. Practical exams commence in the 1st week of April.

3.2. Backlog / Supplementary Exams:
Supplementary examinations for backlogs are conducted during the summer break (June-July) and winter break (December-January). A student can register for a maximum of 4 backlog subjects in any single supplementary attempt.

3.3. Revaluation and Script Verification:
Students dissatisfied with their evaluated semester exam answer scripts may apply for Photostat copy verification within 7 days of result declaration upon payment of $15 / Rs. 500 per subject. Formal re-evaluation request can be submitted within 14 days of result declaration.

### 4. ADMISSION CRITERIA & DEGREE REQUIREMENTS
4.1. Minimum Duration & Credits:
- B.Tech / B.E. Program: 4 Years (8 Semesters). Minimum total credits required for graduation: 160 Credits.
- M.Tech / M.S. Program: 2 Years (4 Semesters). Minimum total credits required for graduation: 68 Credits.
- MBA Program: 2 Years (4 Semesters). Minimum total credits required for graduation: 72 Credits.

4.2. Honors & Minor Degree Option:
Students with a CGPA >= 8.00 at the end of the 4th semester without any standing backlogs are eligible to register for an Honors degree or a specialized Minor degree by taking 18-20 additional credits across Semesters 5 to 8.

# APEX INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY & SCIENCE

## HOSTEL RESIDENCE POLICIES & ACADEMIC FEE STRUCTURE (2026-2027)


### 1. ANNUAL TUITION & COLLEGE FEES

1.1. Undergraduate B.Tech Programs:
- Computer Science & Engineering (CSE / AI & ML / Data Science): $3,200 / Rs. 1,80,000 per academic year.
- Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE): $2,800 / Rs. 1,50,000 per academic year.
- Mechanical & Civil Engineering: $2,400 / Rs. 1,20,000 per academic year.
- Other Institutional Fees (Library, Laboratory, Internet, Sports): $400 / Rs. 25,000 annually.
- One-time Refundable Caution Deposit: $200 / Rs. 10,000 (payable at time of admission).


1.2. Postgraduate M.Tech & MBA Programs:
- M.Tech (All Specializations): $2,200 / Rs. 1,10,000 per academic year.
- MBA (General / FinTech / Analytics): $3,000 / Rs. 1,60,000 per academic year.

1.3. Fee Payment Deadlines:
- Autumn / Odd Semester Fee: Must be deposited by July 31st.
- Spring / Even Semester Fee: Must be deposited by January 15th.
- Late fee penalty of $5 / Rs. 200 per day applies for the first 15 days of delay. After 15 days, student portal access is temporarily frozen.

2.1. Hostel Room Categories & Annual Charges:
- Premium Single Occupancy (AC with Attached Bath): $1,600 / Rs. 95,000 per year.
- Double Occupancy (AC with Attached Bath): $1,200 / Rs. 75,000 per year.
- Double Occupancy (Non-AC with Shared Bath): $850 / Rs. 55,000 per year.
- Triple Occupancy (Non-AC with Shared Bath): $650 / Rs. 42,000 per year.

- Vegetarian & Non-Vegetarian Combined Meal Plan (Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Snacks, Dinner): $900 / Rs. 52,000 per academic year.
- Pure Vegetarian Diet Plan: $800 / Rs. 46,000 per academic year.

### 3. HOSTEL REGULATIONS & CODE OF CONDUCT

3.1. Curfew Timings:
- In-campus hostel entry deadline: 9:30 PM on weekdays (Sunday to Thursday).
- Extended weekend deadline: 10:30 PM on Friday and Saturday with prior digital pass approval.
- Night biometric attendance is conducted strictly at 10:00 PM daily.


3.2. Outstation Night Passes:

3.2. Outstation Night Passes:

Students intending to stay overnight outside the campus or visit hometown must submit an e-pass request through the Student ERP portal at least 24 hours in advance, followed by digital OTP approval from registered parents/guardians.
3.3. Zero-Tolerance Policies:
- Ragging in any form is strictly prohibited under the Supreme Court mandate and leads to immediate expulsion and police reporting.
- Possession or consumption of alcohol, tobacco, narcotics, or prohibited substances within hostel/campus premises results in permanent rustication.
- Electrical appliances such as immersion heaters, induction cookers, and electric irons are not permitted in hostel rooms for fire safety reasons.
# APEX INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY & SCIENCE
## PLACEMENT GUIDELINES, INTERNSHIP POLICIES & SCHOLARSHIP SCHEMES (2026-2027)

### 1. CAMPUS RECRUITMENT TRAINING & PLACEMENT ELIGIBILITY

1.1. Placement Eligibility Criteria:
- Minimum overall CGPA: 6.50 without any active backlogs at the commencement of the 7th semester placement season.
- Minimum 85% attendance in mandatory Campus Recruitment Training (CRT) modules covering Data Structures & Algorithms, Aptitude, System Design, and Soft Skills.
- Completion of at least one verified industrial internship of minimum 6 weeks duration.

1.2. Placement Policy (Dream & Super-Dream Offers):
- Tier 1 (Core / Standard Offer): Annual CTC up to $10,000 / Rs. 8,00,000 per annum.
- Tier 2 (Dream Offer): Annual CTC between $10,000 and $20,000 / Rs. 8,00,000 - Rs. 16,00,000.
- Tier 3 (Super Dream Offer): Annual CTC exceeding $20,000 / Rs. 16,00,000 per annum.
- Policy Rule: A student who secures a Tier 1 offer remains eligible to interview for Tier 2 or Tier 3 companies. Once a student receives a Super Dream offer, they are placed in the "Final Placed" category and cannot apply for additional campus drives to allow other students fair opportunities.

### 2. INSTITUTIONAL SCHOLARSHIPS & FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE

2.1. Merit-Based Scholarships:
- Chairman's Presidential Fellowship: 100% tuition fee waiver for top 5 rank holders in State/National entrance examinations or students maintaining a CGPA >= 9.75.
- Dean's Merit Excellence Award: 50% tuition fee waiver for students maintaining a CGPA between 9.25 and 9.74 in the preceding academic year.
- Academic Merit Scholarship: 25% tuition fee waiver for students maintaining a CGPA between 8.75 and 9.24.

- Academic Merit Scholarship: 25% tuition fee waiver for students maintaining a CGPA between 8.75 and 9.24.


2.2. Need-Based & Special Category Scholarships:
- Economically Weaker Section (EWS) Grant: Up to 50% tuition waiver for students with certified annual family income below $3,500 / Rs. 2,50,000.
- Women in STEM Leadership Grant: $1,000 / Rs. 50,000 annual grant awarded to top female engineering innovators in Computer Science and Robotics.
- Sports & Cultural National Champions Grant: Up to 75% tuition and hostel fee waiver for students representing the country/state in recognized federations.
2.3. How to Apply:

Scholarship application forms are released on the Student ERP portal every year between August 1st and August 31st. Required verification documents include previous semester grade sheets, family income certificate issued by the Revenue Authority, and bank account details.

### 3. LIBRARY RESOURCES & TIMINGS
3.1. Central Digital Library Working Hours:
- Regular Semester Working Hours: Monday to Saturday from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
- Examination Period Working Hours: Open 24/7 with round-the-clock air conditioning, quiet study zones, and high-speed Wi-Fi.
- Sunday & Public Holidays: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

3.2. Borrowing Privileges:
- Undergraduate Students: 4 books for a loan duration of 14 days (renewable twice).
- Postgraduate Students: 6 books for a loan duration of 30 days.
- Overdue fine: $0.20 / Rs. 10 per day per book after the due date.
